Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 37

“Killed, you will attain heaven; victorious, you will enjoy the earth. Therefore rise, Kaunteya, resolved to fight.”

The worldly case concludes with a neat symmetry, and it directly answers Arjuna's earlier complaint that neither winning nor losing offered him anything worth having.
